title: Lipschitz stable sequence classes: an approach to Rademacher type and cotype of Lipschitz functions
summary: In this paper, we extend sequence-class methods from linear and multilinear theory to the Lipschitz setting, highlighting the substantial differences that arise from the lack of linearity. First, we establish a general criterion for lifting a Lipschitz mapping between Banach spaces to a Lipschitz operator between sequence spaces, and we use it to define the class $Π_{(Z,Y)}^{\mathrm{Lip}_0}$ of $(Z,Y)$-summing Lipschitz functions, where $Z$ and $Y$ are sequence classes.
